description: Replacement roof to lower ground floor front extension, extended to form part of raised front garden level; alterations to front vault, including internal dry-lining and replacement door; resurfacing of front lightwells; installation of timber bin store within front lightwell; removal of security grilles from all windows; replacement single-leaf door at upper ground floor rear elevation with French doors; insertion of window at lower ground floor rear elevation; resurfacing of rear sunken terrace, raised balcony and associated external staircase; alterations to and repositioning of rear garden steps; installation of air conditioning condenser unit behind timber trellis screen in rear garden; replacement coal shed with timber garden shed; and associated landscaping works. Internal alterations include reconfiguration of layouts, upgrading building services, and introduction of acoustic isolation measures.
